prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A single, large, dusty wine bottle stands upright on a polished wooden table, its dark glass almost black against a deep, shadowy background. The bottle is enveloped in thick, intricate cobwebs that stretch from its neck to the table, suggesting decades of undisturbed aging. Beside the bottle, a tarnished silver candle holder supports a half-melted black candle, its flame flickering softly and casting a warm, golden glow that highlights the textures of the cobwebs and the aged label on the bottle. The background is pitch black, creating a dramatic contrast and focusing all attention on the bottle and candle. The overall color palette is muted and somber, dominated by blacks, silvers, and the subtle brown of the wood, with the only warmth coming from the candlelight. The composition is intimate and moody, with a shallow depth of field that blurs the background and sharpens the details of the cobwebs and label. The scene evokes a sense of mystery and forgotten time, reminiscent of a gothic still life or a cinematic moment from a suspenseful period film.
